description: This file defines the CandidateDao class, which provides data access methods for candidate-related entities within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions to retrieve, save, delete, and query candidate data, interviews, histories, and associated entities, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builder.

classes.name: CandidateDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing candidate, interview, history, and related entities in recruitment module.

methods.name: getCandidatesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of candidates based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getCandidateById
methods.description: Fetches a candidate entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveCandidate
methods.description: Persists a candidate entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteCandidates
methods.description: Deletes candidates with specified IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves the vacancy associated with a candidate.

methods.name: saveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Persists a candidate vacancy.

methods.name: deleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Deletes vacancy records associated with a candidate.

methods.name: saveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Saves a candidate history record.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecords
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history records based on search filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordsCount
methods.description: Counts candidate history records matching filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordByCandidateIdAndHistoryId
methods.description: Fetches a specific candidate history record by candidate and history IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewByCandidateIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves an interview record based on candidate and interview IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdsByCandidateId
methods.description: Gets a list of interview IDs associated with a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdList
methods.description: Returns list of all candidate history IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Returns candidate history IDs associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns candidate history IDs for candidates linked to a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Obtains vacancy IDs for candidates assigned to a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getCurrentVacancyIdByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves the current vacancy ID for a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Fetches candidate history entries for a candidate and vacancy.

methods.name: getInterviewCountByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Counts interviews for a specific candidate and vacancy.

methods.name: saveCandidateInterview
methods.description: Persists an interview record.

methods.name: getInterviewById
methods.description: Fetches an interview by its ID.

methods.name: isInterviewer
methods.description: Checks if an employee is an interviewer.
